title: SeniorAdministrator - Identity Management
description:
SeniorAdministrator \- Identity Management
Noida, Uttar Pradesh
**Job Summary**
---------------


The Senior Administrator for Support \& Operations plays a crucial role in delivering advanced technical support and operational excellence in Identity Management. This position is key in ensuring the integrity and security of the CyberArk PAM environment while enhancing customer satisfaction through effective troubleshooting and root cause analysis.
**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


1\. Provide Advanced Technical Support By Troubleshooting Complex Cyberark Pam Incidents, Utilizing Vault, Pvwa, Cpm, And Psm To Implement Effective Solutions And Resolve Security Issues.
  

2\. Conduct Thorough Root Cause Analysis For Escalated Incidents, Ensuring Adherence To Quality Standards And Regulatory Requirements To Enhance Operational Efficiency.
  

3\. Contribute To Knowledge Management By Updating The Knowledge Base, Developing Training Materials, And Coaching New Analysts On Cyberark Pam Best Practices And Operational Procedures.
  

4\. Resolve Complex Support Tickets Within Established Slas, Collaborating With Cross\-Functional Teams To Ensure Seamless Operations And Maintain A Strong Security Posture.
  

5\. Enhance Customer Experience And Csat By Driving First Call Resolution Initiatives, Minimizing Rejected Resolutions, And Proactively Addressing Potential Security Threats.
**Skill Requirements**
----------------------


1\. In\-Depth Knowledge Of Identity Management Principles And Cyberark Pam Components Including Vault, Pvwa, Cpm, And Psm.
  

2\. Strong Analytical And Problem\-Solving Skills With A Focus On Root Cause Analysis And Incident Management.
  

3\. Proficient In Developing And Managing Knowledge Base Content And Conducting Training For Support Teams.
  

4\. Excellent Communication Skills To Facilitate Collaboration Across Teams And Ensure Positive Customer Interactions.  

  

  

**Other Requirements**
----------------------


1\. Optional But Valuable Certifications: Cyberark Certified Trustee, Cyberark Certified Scripting Professional

title: SeniorAdministrator - Asset Management, ServiceNow
description:
Noida, Uttar Pradesh
  
Job Summary
  
  

The ServiceNow L2 Analyst provides advanced operational support for the ServiceNow platform, handling incidents, service requests, problem investigations, and minor enhancements across ITSM modules while ensuring platform stability and SLA adherence
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Resolve L2\-level incidents and service requests for ServiceNow (Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge, CMDB).
* Perform root cause analysis and support problem management activities.
* Configure and maintain workflows, business rules, client scripts, UI policies, and notifications.
* Support CMDB health, data quality, and CI relationships.
* Assist with change implementations, testing, and deployments in non\-prod/prod environments.
* Coordinate with L3/development teams for complex issues and enhancements.
* Monitor system performance, queues, SLA breaches, and platform alerts.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, SOPs, and knowledge articles.
* Support integrations and basic troubleshooting of APIs and data imports.
* Ensure compliance with ITSM processes, security policies, and audit requirements


Skill Requirements
  
  

* 2–4 years of hands\-on ServiceNow platform experience.
* Strong understanding of ITIL/ITSM processes.
* Experience with ServiceNow scripting (basic JavaScript preferred).
* Knowledge of CMDB concepts and data governance.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow update sets, development lifecycle, and releases.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills


Other Requirements
  
  

**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* ITIL Foundation certification.
* ServiceNow CSA and/or ITSM implementation certifications.
* Experience supporting enterprise or regulated environments.


Mid\-level ServiceNow support professional responsible for handling incidents, service requests, and change tasks, performing workflow/configuration troubleshooting, and supporting ITSM modules (Incident, Problem, Change, CMDB) with minimal supervision

description:
**Req ID:** 375974
  
  

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  

We are currently seeking a Security Center Operations Specialist to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN\-UP), India (IN).
  
  

Role Responsibilities
  
•
  
* Understand and apply principles, concepts, technologies and standards of professional field
* Apply research information gathering and analytical and interpretation skills to problems of diverse scope
* Write/create formal documentation such as reports, slide decks, and architecture diagrams
* Lead and/or assist incident response efforts
* Create content (queries, dashboards, reports, etc.) in industry leading SIEM tools, such as Splunk
* Support and participate in SOC engineering efforts such as tool integration, development of automation, scripts, testing of new tools and evaluation of new technologies
* Make recommendations for improving procedures
* Evaluate/deconstruct malware through open\-source and vendor provided tools
* Resolve client issues by taking the appropriate corrective action, or following the appropriate escalation procedures
* Utilize ticketing system and standard operating procedures for effective call processing and escalation to adhere to client Service Level Agreement (SLA)
* Perform all tasks required per shift including reporting, monitoring, and turnover logs
* Evaluate the type and severity of security events by making use of packet analyses and in\-depth understanding of exploits and vulnerabilities
* Confidently communicate technical information to NTT Data Services client base and internal technical team members
* Participate in knowledge sharing with other analysts and develop efficient customer solutions
* Maintain a working knowledge of local security policies and execute general controls as assigned


Role Requirements
  
•
  
* Bachelor’s degree in related filed, to include computer science, or equivalent combination of education and experience
* 2 \-4 years of SIEM, or Splunk Enterprise Security experience
* Strong communication, written, and verbal skills
* Experience with writing/creation of formal documentation such as reports, slide decks, and architecture diagrams
* Root cause analysis experience, getting to the root cause, problem solving
* Investigative and analytical problem solving skills
* Customer service/support experience


Role Preferences
  
•
  
* Splunk certification
* Coding or scripting experience
* Familiarity with Unix/Linux
* Security\+, or similar certification
* Security\+, GIAC, SSGB, ITIL, or similar certification
* Working knowledge of applicable industry controls such as NIST 800\-53


Typical Years of Experience
  
•
  
* 5\-7 Years relevant work experience


About NTT DATA
  
  

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start\-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in RD.
  
  

Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in\-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. NTT DATA recruiters will never ask for payment or banking information and will only use @nttdata.com, @nttdatafed.com and @talent.nttdataservices.com email addresses. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact\-us.
